newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius sells treasury bills worth $22 million.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius sells treasury bills worth $22 million.

text.p: The central Bank of Mauritius said on Thursday that it sold all 450 million rupees ($22 million) worth of T-bills it offered at this week's auction.
The central bank sold 91-day bills worth 104.6 million rupees at a weighted average yield of 9.82 percent at the auction against 157.8 million rupees at 9.95 percent last week.

The bank sold 182-day bills worth 229.6 million rupees with an average yield of 10.07 percent against 328.9 million rupees at 10.24 percent last week. It sold 364-day bills worth 115.8 million rupees at an average yield of 10.06 percent against 163.3 million rupees at 10.27 percent last week.
This week's effective bank rate was posted at 10.01 percent per annum from 10.18 percent last week, the bank said.
